summary: Pixel and Pine Studio will design and update Northwind Retail Group's product catalogue each month for $6,000 a month, paid within forty-five days of each invoice. Northwind can change the scope, the fees or any other term by written notice, effective fifteen days later. The agreement runs for twenty-four months from December 1, 2026 and renews by itself for twelve months at a time unless Pixel and Pine gives written notice at least ninety days before a term ends. If Pixel and Pine ends it early, it pays Northwind a $10,000 termination fee. Dana Whitfield, the studio's sole member, personally guarantees all of its obligations. Pixel and Pine covers Northwind against all losses, damages and costs from the services, including lost profits and indirect losses. Texas law applies.
